Please Try Again. Powered by Reelgood Shrinking stans, we’ve got bad news. Season 3 of Apple TV‘s acclaimed grief comedy is almost over, which means it’s time to mentally prep for what’s sure to be another brilliant, affecting finale. As Decider noted in our full Season 3 review, “Without spoiling major storylines, when the end credits roll on Shrinking Season 3, there’s a clear sense of closure within the group. Co-creator Bill Lawrence likely completed the three-season arc he initially pitched, and it would be an incredibly satisfying, full-circle conclusion.” With Alice (Lukita Maxwell) headed to off to college at Wesleyan, Paul (Harrison Ford) retiring and moving to Connecticut to be with his family, and a slew of other major life changes happening within the friend group, viewers are likely wondering does Shrinking end with Season 3? How many episodes in Shrinking Season 3? And will the hit series return to deliver more hearty laughs and cathartic cries? Curious how many episodes are in Shrinking Season 3? When do new episodes of Shrinking premiere on Apple TV? Is Harrison Ford leaving Shrinking? When is the Shrinking Season 3 finale? And will there be a Shrinking Season 4? We’ve got you covered. Here’s everything you need to know about the future of Bill Lawrence, Brett Goldstein, and Jason Segel’s beloved comfort watch. How Many Episodes Are In Shrinking Season 3? Shrinking Season 1 had 10 episodes, Season 2 featured 12 episodes, and Shrinking Season 3 consists of 11 episodes. When Does Shrinking‘s Season 3 Finale? Shrinking Season 3, Episode 11 Premiere Date: Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEShrinking‘s Season 3 finale aka Shrinking Season 3, Episode 11 premieres Wednesday, April 8 on Apple TV. But locked-in Apple TV subscribers know you can watch the episode earlier depending on which time zone you live in. Here’s what we mean by that… What Time Does Shrinking Come Out On Apple TV? Apple TV regularly releases new episodes at 9:00 p.m. ET the night before designated premiere dates, so if you’re extra eager to watch, keep your eyes peeled Shrinking‘s Season 3 finale on Tuesday, April 7 at 9:00 p.m. ET. Photo: Apple TV When Do New Episodes of Shrinking Come Out? Shrinking Season 3 Episode Guide: Want to look back at a Shrinking Season 3 episode guide as we approach the finale? We’ve got you covered. Below is Shrinking‘s Season 3 release schedule for January, February, March, and April. Season 3, Episode 1, “My Bad”: Wednesday, January 28 Season 3, Episode 2, “Happiness Mission”: Wednesday, February 4 Season 3, Episode 3, “D-Day”: Wednesday, February 11 Season 3, Episode 4, “The Field”: Wednesday, February 18 Season 3, Episode 5, “Hold Your Horsies”: Wednesday, February 25 Season 3, Episode 6, “Derek’s Don’t Die”: Wednesday, March 4 Season 3, Episode 7, “I Will Be Grape”: Wednesday, March 11 Season 3, Episode 8, “Depression Diet”: Wednesday, March 18 Season 3, Episode 9, “Daddy Issues”: Wednesday, March 25 Season 3, Episode 10, “The Bodyguard of Sadness”: Wednesday, April 1 Season 3, Episode 11: Wednesday, April 8 Will There Be A Shrinking Season 4 On Apple TV? Or Is Shrinking Ending? You bet! On Tuesday, January 27, hours before Shrinking Season 3’s supersized premiere was set to stream, Apple TV announced a rare, incredibly early Season 4 renewal. Speaking as a Ted Lasso fan who was lightly traumatized when viewers reached the end of Season 3 with no confirmation that it was, indeed, the end (but also not really!), Shrinking‘s early renewal was an incredibly refreshing, smart, considerate move. Stay tuned for more Shrinking Season 4 updates following Season 3’s finale. Is Harrison Ford Leaving Shrinking? As we approach the end of Season 3, viewers can’t help but wonder: Is Harrison Ford leaving Shrinking?! Why? Decider went deep on fan fears and shared our thoughts on Ford’s Shrinking future, but the worries essentially stem from the fact that Paul retired and plans to move to Connecticut. At the time of writing this article, there’s been no confirmation that Ford is leaving the series. And after Season 3 wrapped, the actor delivered an emotional speech to cast and crew, saying, “You guys are the best. The very, very best, at what you do and how you do it. And how you make people feel is just fucking amazing. I love this place. I love working with you guys. I hope we can all get back here and do it again.” Another hopeful sign that Ford isn’t leaving the series? Alice (Lukita Maxwell) is going to college at Wesleyan University, also in Connecticut! So if Paul does go through with the move, there’s definite potential there. There’s always a chance that Shrinking could reveal Ford is stepping back from the role ahead of Season 4, but he’s been incredibly open about his love of the show, as well as the fulfillment, pleasure, and pride he takes in the work. So try not to worry, and again, stay tuned for more updates. Where To Watch Shrinking: Apple TV Streaming Info Since Shrinking is an Apple TV original series, you’ll have to subscribe to the platform to watch new and existing episodes. Apple TV comes with a seven-day free trial for new subscribers and has just one ad-free streaming plan available for $13.99/month. Stay tuned for more Shrinking Season 3 coverage on Decider.
